summary: P1 Two-envelope sealed bidding — end-to-end backend + frontend verified. Backend: 21 new tests in TestV16TwoEnvelope + 9 baseline (TestHealth + TestAuth) = 30/30 PASS in 11.32s. Coverage: create RFP with two_envelope=true (persistence via GET), non-two-envelope regression, 2 vendors submit sealed bids, GET /api/bids masking (buyer sees _technical_sealed & _commercial_sealed with all commercial + technical fields null pre-open), vendor sees own bid unmasked, score/qualify/award/open-commercial all correctly blocked before technical opened, open-technical 400 on non-two-envelope, 403 for non-owner buyer, open-technical unseals technical fields but keeps commercial sealed, open-commercial requires ≥1 qualified bid (400 otherwise), qualify bid A=true / B=false, open-commercial success (returns qualified_bids count), post-open masking shows bid A price 190000 revealed while bid B still sealed (not qualified), qualification locked after commercial opened (400), award bid B blocked (not qualified), award bid A succeeds → tender status=awarded. Frontend (Playwright, buyer session): (STAGE1) rfp-two-envelope checkbox on /buyer/create?type=rfp with proper label 'TWO-ENVELOPE SEALED BIDDING', on /tenders/{id} rfp-two-envelope-badge, two-envelope-panel with te-stage-label='Stage 1 · Sealed', te-open-technical button visible, te-open-commercial hidden, rfp-scoring-locked shown 'Scoring is locked until Technical envelopes are opened above.', both price-cell-{id} = 'SEALED', all score inputs disabled=true, all Award buttons disabled=true. (STAGE2) after clicking te-open-technical: stage='Stage 2 · Technical open · Qualifying', te-open-technical removed, te-open-commercial visible & disabled (qualified=0), rfp-scoring-locked removed, 2× qualify-{id} + 2× disqualify-{id} buttons appear, price cells still 'SEALED'. (STAGE3) after qualify+disqualify+open-commercial: stage='Stage 3 · Commercial open · Awarding', qualified bid price-cell shows 'USD 175,000 · 100d', other still 'SEALED', qualified bid Award button disabled=false, disqualified bid Award button disabled=true. Regression: non-two-envelope RFP shows no badge/panel/locked state, price visible ('USD 120,000 · 60d'), scoring inputs enabled. Perf fix verified: POST /api/tenders now returns fast (~0.5s) — email fan-out moved to asyncio.create_task at server.py L608; no 15s timeouts observed across 30 tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L594-608 email fan-out is now correctly moved to asyncio.create_task — POST /api/tenders returns fast. Good fix; unblocks TestV13/V14 latent timeouts.

server.py L679-708 _mask_bid_for_two_envelope correctly zeros commercial fields including price_amount/price_currency/delivery_days/proposal/commercial_proposal/line_item_prices AND attachments (attachments emptied). Vendors always get unmasked view (skipped at L686-688). Symmetric with spec.

server.py L807-810 score endpoint blocks scoring on two-envelope pre-tech-open. But it does NOT block scoring an un-qualified bid post-tech-open — buyer can still score bids they later disqualify. That's actually correct behavior since scoring feeds qualification decisions.
server.py L841-845 award endpoint has proper double-gate (commercial_opened_at AND technical_qualified=true). Awards on non-two-envelope RFPs bypass both gates — regression-safe.
server.py L1054-1055 qualify endpoint correctly locks after commercial_opened_at is set (400 'qualification is locked'). This prevents mid-award qualification changes.

server.py L1023-1026 open-commercial requires qualified_count > 0 — good UX gate. But if buyer qualifies 1 bid then later disqualifies it, they still cannot un-open commercial (irreversible). Acceptable but worth documenting for buyer runbook.

TenderDetail.jsx L505-511 te-open-technical only rendered when !techOpen; te-open-commercial only when techOpen && !commOpen. Correct per spec. `disabled={busy==='comm' || qualified===0}` — properly gates the button.
TenderDetail.jsx L797 price-cell-{id} uses priceCell(b) helper which returns 'SEALED' pmc-label when _commercial_sealed, else '{ccy} {amount} · {days}d'. Verified both states in UI.
CreateTender.jsx L353-367 two-envelope checkbox is only inside the RFP-only block (guarded by document_type === 'rfp' in enclosing conditional at L332ish) — correct.
Minor code smell: TenderDetail.jsx has 862 lines — TwoEnvelopePanel (~65 lines) + RfpScoringMatrix (~200 lines) could be extracted into components/tender/ for maintainability. Non-blocking.

server.py two-envelope endpoints do not broadcast a distinct SSE event type — they reuse 'tender.updated' with technical_opened_at/commercial_opened_at payload. Consumers (feed) currently look at status only, so this is fine for now; document if any client wants live envelope-state UI without polling.
